report:
The wallet module is built and verified against a running API. Of the 27 ledger rows, 21 are IMPLEMENTED and 6 are PARTIAL (WAL-02, WAL-05, WAL-09, WAL-16, WAL-17, WAL-24; reasons in the per-row notes). It covers the overview, deposit, withdraw, history, transaction detail, withdrawal tracker, whitelist, connected wallets and the banners and modals. Mobile uses true bottom-sheet patterns.

**Web**
- Routes (all under apps/web/src/app/(app)/wallet/):
  - `/wallet`
  - `/wallet/deposit` (step and deposit reference kept in the URL)
  - `/wallet/withdraw` (the unsent draft is kept in sessionStorage `gp.withdrawDraft`)
  - `/wallet/withdraw/[reference]` (the tracker)
  - `/wallet/history` (`?tx=` opens the detail drawer)
  - `/wallet/connected`
  - `/wallet/whitelist`
- Components are in /home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/web/src/components/wallet/ (16 files).
- API wrappers and TanStack hooks are in /home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/web/src/lib/api/wallet.ts. They use the shared `apiRequest()`; the client was not forked.
- Money stays a decimal string throughout (`@gp/shared/money`). Every financial write sends an idempotency key, created once per user intent and reused on retries.
- The deposit QR is rendered in the browser from the address with the `qrcode` package (`qr-code.tsx`).
- Below 768 px the deposit and withdraw flows open as a bottom sheet over the wallet page (MOB-06/07). Option pickers, the transaction detail, filters and all modals become bottom sheets too.
- Clearly labelled DEMO controls exist for "Simulate testnet deposit", "Add 5 confirmations / Auto-advance" and "Simulate testnet confirmation" (the last one is for queued withdrawals).
- Dev-only previews (`NEXT_PUBLIC_STATE_PREVIEW`): `?preview=wrong-network`, `?preview=expired` and `?preview=delayed` on the deposit flow.

**Shared component change:** `ui/button.tsx` with `asChild` now renders `leadingIcon` / `trailingIcon` inside the child element. Before, these icons were silently dropped. Without icons the behaviour is unchanged.

**API additions** (additive; new files are `withdrawal-precheck.service.ts` and `demo-deposits.service.ts`):
- `GET /wallet/status`: whether deposits and withdrawals are switched on, plus KYC daily limit, used today, remaining and reset time.
- `GET /withdrawals/precheck`: read-only risk check before 2FA, with 6 checks. Outcome is pass, review, kyc_required or blocked (with a code). It writes no AML alert.
- `GET /withdrawals/ref/:reference`: the withdrawal plus its stored screening, for the tracker.
- `GET /deposits/ref/:reference`: one deposit, polled by the pending step.
- `POST /dev/deposits/simulate` accepts `mode: 'progressive'`, which records the deposit as detected at 0/20. `POST /dev/deposits/:reference/confirmations` then adds simulated confirmations and credits it through the normal posting path. Both are DEMO only.
- `AmlService.previewWithdrawal()` was added.
- In @gp/shared: `demoDepositSimulationSchema.mode`, `demoDepositAdvanceSchema`, `withdrawalPrecheckQuerySchema`, and the types `WalletStatus`, `WithdrawalPrecheck`, `PrecheckCheck`.
- Tests: apps/api/test/wallet.e2e-spec.ts (7 tests). It cancels the withdrawal it creates so it leaves nothing open in the shared test DB.
- docs/API.md and docs/WEB_COMPONENTS.md have new wallet sections. I did not run prettier on these shared docs, and `prettier --check` flags both files.

**Verification (exact results)**
- Web `pnpm --filter @gp/web typecheck`: exit 0.
- Web `lint`: exit 0.
- Web `test`: 10 files, 95 tests passed, including test/wallet.test.tsx (8 tests).
- Production build `flock /tmp/gp-web-build.lock env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-wallet[-b] … pnpm --filter @gp/web build`: passed twice (exit 0). After the second build I made one small change in tx-detail.tsx (no minus sign on a 0.00 fee, plus a full stop). Typecheck, lint and test passed after it, but no third build was run.
- Playwright e2e `apps/web/e2e/wallet.spec.ts`: 1 passed in 15.1 s, against the production build on :3104 and the API on :4104. It covers deposit through credited, withdraw through manual review, cancel, and history with the detail drawer.
- API `typecheck`: exit 0.
- API `lint`: 0 errors and 1 warning, in another agent's prisma/seed-admin-ops.ts.
- API `pnpm test` (final run): unit 14 files / 59 tests passed; e2e 13 files / 100 tests passed.
- An earlier run had one failure in admin.e2e ("FOUR EYES"). The admin queue lists open withdrawals oldest first, 20 per page, and the shared test DB had collected 28 open reviews. That test passed on the final run.

**Screenshots:** 61 PNGs (35 at 1440, 26 at 390) are in /home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/web/test-results/visual/wallet/ as `WAL-xx_<state>_<width>.png`. All have 0 px horizontal overflow and no page errors. They were compared with the Figma references; fixes from that comparison:
- history became a table on desktop with 5 lifetime tiles and the filters in the card toolbar;
- the tracker was rebuilt to the WAL-22 layout;
- mobile action tiles were added;
- the grid overflow at 390 px was fixed;
- button icons now render.

A 768 px check was done on the deposit address step.

**Figma:** 7 key frames saved to /home/user/Claude/design/reference/wallet/ (WAL-01, WAL-05, WAL-07, WAL-13, WAL-20, WAL-22 at 1440; MOB-05 at 390). 4 calls were refused by the rate limit and not hammered. The rest of the copy came from the results JSON and the pending build scripts.

**Remaining differences from Figma:**
- No ID/hash search on history.
- No "notify me" toggle on the tracker.
- No bonus-funds row on the asset step.
- No email-code field on 2FA.
- The withdraw stepper context uses the network name, not "Arbitrum One".

**Cleanup:** every server I started is stopped (web :3104, API :4104). My `.next-wallet*` dist dirs and the private API build dir are removed. Only my own `.next-wallet*` lines were removed from apps/web/tsconfig.json; other agents' lines are untouched.

**Data left behind:** in the shared dev DB, DEMO players `did:privy:wallet-qa-01` and `did:privy:e2e-wallet-*` hold simulated deposits and cancelled withdrawals. @nova.k was only read.

**Memory:** I read project_global_pool_figma.md (file key, BC.GAME casino direction) for context. Nothing new needs saving.

decisions: Non-whitelisted destinations follow the API's server policy: they are allowed and the first withdrawal goes to a manual AML review. Figma's new-address cooldown state shows Continue disabled; here the user is offered either 'withdraw now (review, usually under 4 h)' or 'add to whitelist (24 h cooldown)'. Whitelisted addresses still in cooldown are blocked. Needs a product/compliance sign-off.

2FA for withdrawals and whitelist changes uses the authenticator code only, sent as totpCode with the protected request (single use) and showing the anti-phishing code. There is no email code because the API has no email OTP; this matches the owner decision of TOTP + anti-phishing.
Withdrawals need an explicit 'Confirm withdrawal · amount' press; the code is not auto-submitted on the 6th digit.
The 30-minute 'address session' on the deposit step is a client-side safety re-check (the address is masked and must be refreshed). The HD deposit address itself never changes, and the copy says so.
A deposit still confirming after 10 minutes is shown as 'Delayed', with the honest note that no action is needed and support is available after 60 minutes.
New read-only GET /withdrawals/precheck runs the same deterministic checks as POST /withdrawals but writes no AML alert; POST re-checks everything authoritatively.
DEMO progressive deposits (mode 'progressive' plus the dev confirmations endpoint) let the pending flow be exercised without a chain. DEMO only, same ledger postings.
The confirmation step's balance before/after is derived from current balances (Available − amount, Pending + amount).
Explorer links are hidden for DEMO hashes (they would point to non-existent testnet transactions).
Shared Button (asChild) now renders leading/trailing icons inside the child through Radix Slottable. Additive change to a shared component.
Every wallet page shows DEMO badges; there is no VPN hint, no fake urgency, and withdrawals are never blocked by RG limits.

report:
POOL module (GLOBAL POOL, DEMO/testnet) is built and checked against the API. The official production build passes; it was run under the flock. The e2e happy path passes three times. Of the 16 ledger rows, 13 are verified and 3 (GP-06, GP-13, PUB-07) are PARTIAL: one state each is built but not screenshot-checked.

ROUTES (apps/web/src/app/(app)/…)
- /pool: GP-01 hub, MOB-04 mobile, PUB-02 guest variant.
- /pool/rounds/[number]: one page that follows the round status. Drawing or VRF-delayed shows GP-05 / GP-13; settled shows GP-07 public results plus GP-06 "your result"; cancelled shows GP-09 refunds; open or scheduled shows a summary.
- /pool/rounds/[number]/verify: GP-12.
- /pool/history: GP-08. /pool/entries: GP-10. /pool/prizes: GP-11. /provably-fair: PUB-07.

COMPONENTS (apps/web/src/components/pool/)
- use-pool.ts: TanStack hooks, a real clock, and the live socket.io `/pool` feed. Socket events patch the round and feed caches directly.
- logic.ts: pure logic. Participation check (balance plus RG participation and loss limits), round phases including `not_open_yet` and `delayed`, odds display rounded DOWN, and verifyDraw, which re-derives the winners and prize split in the browser with @gp/contracts/verify.
- parts.tsx, participate-flow.tsx (GP-02/03/04 plus the GP-13 "round closed" outcome; dialog from 768px, bottom sheet below), pool-hub.tsx, round-page.tsx, verify-page.tsx, history-page.tsx, entries-page.tsx, prizes-page.tsx, provably-fair-page.tsx, preview.ts (dev `?state=` flags: guest, restricted, no-round, wrong-network, participate).
- API wrappers are in apps/web/src/lib/api/pool.ts and use the shared apiRequest(). In mock mode it serves shifted DEMO data; buying entries is always refused in mock mode.

PARTICIPATION
- Form uses RHF + zod (shared enterRoundSchema). The consent box is never pre-checked.
- Line items: entries × 10.00, the 0.05 platform fee as its own line, network fee 0.00, total, and Available after.
- Shows the shared oddsDisclosure (exact, rounded down) and the RG limit check (within / limit reached, with "Reduce to N").
- Insufficient funds offers Deposit and "Reduce to N". The wrong-network state is reachable only through the preview flag.
- Also shown: licence card, "You can lose your stake", and a gold Confirm button.
- One idempotency key per intent, reused on retry. Server error codes ROUND_NOT_OPEN, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS and RG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED each map to their UI state.

HOMEPAGE CLOCK FIX
- New apps/web/src/lib/data/demo-clock.ts uses the same whole-day shift as the API seed (round closes at the next 20:00 UTC; between rounds, the next 08:00).
- mock-home.ts now shifts every DEMO date and sets serverNow to the real now. home-page.tsx passes demoNow=undefined, so countdowns use the real clock in both api and mock mode.
- pool-live.tsx: relative times no longer invent "0 s ago" for rows dated later today, the chart date range is computed from the data, and API feed rows without roundNumber no longer break.
- test/home.test.tsx pins Date to the DEMO snapshot moment.

API ADDITIONS (additive, pool module)
- GET /pool/me/entries (player): one row per purchase with entry amount, the separate platform fee, network fee, total and result (in_draw / drawing / won / not_selected / refund_owed / refunded), plus a lifetime summary. New file: apps/api/src/modules/pool/entry-history.service.ts.
- GET /pool/rounds gains optional `?status=settled,cancelled&number=1245` filters (RoundsService.history takes a second optional argument).
- New e2e test apps/api/test/pool-history.e2e-spec.ts (3 tests). docs/API.md and docs/WEB_COMPONENTS.md updated.

QA SETUP
- Private API on :4105 and web on :3105.
- I used an isolated QA database, globalpool_pool (migrated and seeded), so e2e purchases would not change the shared ledger. The seed's random admin/TOTP credentials file was restored to the shared one immediately after seeding.
- I drove the real RoundLifecycleService (mock VRF): close → draw → settle of round #1,248, then opened #1,249. Settlement re-derived 13 winners from 18,646 entries, and the browser verifier shows 4 / 4 checks passed.

FIGMA REFERENCES
12 frames saved to /home/user/Claude/design/reference/pool/: GP-01 at 1440 and 390, GP-02, GP-05, GP-07, GP-08, GP-09, GP-10, GP-11, GP-12, GP-13 delayed, PUB-07. The seat limit refused several other calls.

REMAINING VISUAL DIFFERENCES
- Hub recent entries: a pool-only table instead of the mixed-game Live Bets table, because mixed-game rows would be invented data.
- GP-11: a split bar instead of a donut.
- GP-10: a side receipt panel instead of an expandable row.
- On-chain record links and the entry snapshot root are shown as not yet published.

MEMORY
The stored GLOBAL POOL Figma note (from memory) matched the brief and I followed its casino direction. Nothing new to save.

decisions: BUSINESS RULE CONFLICT (needs an owner decision): the API does not refund platform fees when a round is cancelled ('platform fees are not refunded', API.md), but Figma GP-09/11/13 say fees go back to Available. The UI shows the API rule: 'Platform fees are not refunded'.
Prizes: in the API, prizes land in Owed and the player claims them (POST /wallet/owed/claim). Figma shows an automatic move to Available after 20 confirmations. The UI shows the API behaviour.

Odds use the exact formula from @gp/shared oddsDisclosure (prizes drawn without replacement) and are rounded DOWN so a chance is never overstated: ≈2.41% any prize instead of Figma's 2.44% upper-bound approximation.
No nudging: the participation modal defaults to 1 entry (Figma shows 35). The limit shown is the API's max 1,000 per purchase (Figma says 'max 500 per round').

'Wallet disconnected' maps to the signed-out state: with Privy and hybrid custody, entries are paid from the platform balance. The wrong-network state is UI-only (dev preview flag) until auth exposes the wallet chain.

GP-03 shows honest steps for a single DB transaction, with no fake confirmation counts or tx hash. On-chain record links and the entry snapshot root are shown as 'not published yet' (snapshot check is informational).
Module tabs are Overview / My entries / Round history / Prize distribution / Fairness (VRF), instead of Figma's Winners / Rules / Refunds.

Hub recent entries show only real pool purchases from GET /pool/rounds/:n/feed, not the mixed-game Live Bets table, which would need fabricated game rows. Participant avatars come from real feed handles; hard-coded initials removed.

QA ran against an isolated database (globalpool_pool) instead of the shared dev DB, so e2e purchases do not move shared balances or round totals. QA-only changes there: round #1,248 opens_at set to now−2h; #1,248 closed / drawn / settled through the real lifecycle (mock VRF); requested_at backdated to show the delayed state, then restored to close+4s; round #1,249 opened.
